value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: Korg keeps Thor company in New Asgard through five years of despair, and Thor threatens an online gamer who insults Korg.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The friend whose house Korg shares in New Asgard. Threatens a gamer who insults him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who keeps Thor company through five dark years in New Asgard.

verdicts.why: Korg games with Thor at his New Asgard house and Thor threatens NoobMaster69 for insulting Korg; fixed the ambiguous 'insults him' in the text.

In 2012 Stark Tower, with Loki defeated and held at arrow point, Natasha takes his scepter before handing it to Sitwell; a scene together, and the film treats the 2012 heroes as their own past selves.
The captured Loki ridicules Captain America in Stark Tower before Thor gags him with the collar.
Tony (2012) carries the Tesseract case while escorting Loki; after the heist goes wrong the case slides to Loki's feet and he escapes with it.
On the Benatar after the funeral Nebula and Mantis are both in the Guardians; Nebula says 'Sounds fair' to Drax's fight idea and Mantis says 'please use knives'.
Rocket: 'I got some blasters unless you guys want to use knives?' Mantis: 'Oh, yes, please use knives.'

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: In the battle against Thanos, a Gamora from 2014 knocks Quill down, and he turns to Nebula, confused, as she tells Gamora that her other self fell for him. Afterward Nebula joins Quill's Guardians on the Benatar.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardian whose Gamora fell for him. Nebula joins his team after the war.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Explains Quill to a Gamora from 2014, then joins his Guardians.

verdicts.why: On Morag it is Rhodes who punches the 2014 Quill out (Nebula only takes his tools), so the proposed text is wrong; the real exchange is in the battle, where Quill turns to Nebula after the 2014 Gamora knocks him down and Nebula tells her the other Gamora fell for him, and then Nebula joins his Guardians on the Benatar.
On the first day of the new school year after the Blip, Ned sees Peter and they share an emotional reunion ('Dude!').
After the Blip, Okoye, T'Challa and Shuri walk out of a portal together and lead Wakanda's armies into the Battle of Earth.
Okoye, reunited with her king, walks through the portal beside T'Challa and leads the Wakandan armies with him.
Rocket and Quill attend Tony's funeral with the reunited Guardians; on the Benatar, as Quill's leadership is challenged by Thor, Rocket offers blasters.
Tony is dead at his funeral and is seen only in a recorded message; the owner's rule says a person seen only in a recording, with no exchange, is not a stage, so attending the funeral gives no stage.
Restored on Titan, Quill, Drax, Mantis and Peter Parker are told by Strange that five years have passed, and he opens the portal that brings them to the Battle of Earth.
On the Benatar Quill moves Thor's hand off the map and says 'this is my ship still. I'm in charge'; Thor answers 'of course you are', and they laugh off the fight the team suggests.
Strange meets Wong after the portals open: 'Is that everyone?' 'What, you wanted more?' Wong brought the sorcerers of Kamar-Taj.
T'Challa shares a glance with a battle-weary Steve, who is visibly relieved, then joins the charge Steve leads.

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: As T'Challa runs with the gauntlet, Thanos charges at him, but Wanda blocks the Titan's path and fights him while T'Challa runs on.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The witch who blocks Thanos's charge at T'Challa.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The king Wanda saves from Thanos's charge.

verdicts.why: Wanda does block Thanos as he charges at T'Challa, but she is driven by revenge for Vision; nothing shows she does it 'so T'Challa can get away', so the purpose clause is dropped.

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: Thor joins the Guardians aboard the Benatar, and Quill reminds him that it is still his ship and he is in charge. Thor agrees, and they laugh off the idea of fighting for the lead.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Joins Quill's Guardians, and agrees Quill is in charge.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The Guardian who tells Thor the ship is still his.

verdicts.why: Endgame leaves them teammates: Thor joins Quill's Guardians and agrees Quill is in charge, and they laugh off fighting for it, so the through-line is no longer rivalry; ally, as in item 13.

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: As T'Challa runs for the van with the gauntlet, Thanos knocks him down with his sword and charges at him, until Wanda blocks his path.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Knocks T'Challa down with his sword to get the gauntlet.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Runs with the gauntlet until Thanos knocks him down with his sword.

verdicts.why: T'Challa is knocked down by Thanos's sword while running with the gauntlet, then charged and saved by Wanda; but this Thanos never held the Nano Gauntlet, so 'take back' on T'Challa's card is wrong.
The Guardians pick Thor up at New Asgard, and in the leadership banter Mantis says 'Oh, yes, please use knives.'

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: Rhodes and Thor join the strike at the Garden, where Rhodes doubts Thanos's claim that the Stones are gone and Thor beheads Thanos.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger on the strike against Thanos at the Garden.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger on the strike at the Garden, where Thor beheads Thanos.

verdicts.why: Rhodes and Thor are both on the Garden strike, where Rhodes suspects Thanos is lying and Thor beheads him; the text's pronouns ('his claim', 'vouches for him', 'beheads him') do not make clear who is meant, and Nebula's part is a third person's act, so it is cut.

There is only one MCU Gamora file (id 'gamora'). It holds both the original and the 2014 Gamora, and its desc shows her latest state. So the Infinity War stage with the original Gamora is on the right file and nothing needs to move.

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: In 2012 New York, Sitwell and Rumlow's STRIKE team take Loki's scepter to move it for HYDRA. Rumlow refuses to give it to Steve, but they hand it over once Steve whispers "Hail Hydra" to Sitwell.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow HYDRA mole moving the scepter with Rumlow's team in 2012.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The STRIKE leader beside Sitwell as they move the scepter in 2012.

verdicts.why: The scene is right, but sources disagree on who hands over the scepter (Sitwell's page says Sitwell, Rumlow's says Rumlow), so the text no longer names who does it; Steve does whisper 'Hail Hydra' to Sitwell.
Ayo is with T'Challa and the Dora Milaje when the Avengers arrive in Birnin Zana, then stays behind to protect Shuri and fights Corvus Glaive.
Loki tells Thanos 'we have a Hulk', and the Hulk springs from hiding to attack Thanos on the Statesman.
Banner finds the phone Steve left Tony and calls Steve about the threat to Vision, reunites with him at the Compound, fights in Wakanda and tells him 'Cap. That's him.'

On the Statesman Thor attacks Thanos after the Hulk is beaten and Heimdall sends the Hulk away; in Wakanda Thor's Bifrost arrival wipes out the Outriders mobbing Banner, who is happy his friend survived.
Banner reaches Tony through Strange's portal, warns him about Thanos and convinces him to call Steve; Tony fights Cull Obsidian to protect him when the Hulk will not come out.
At the Compound Banner proposes removing the Stone, saying Vision is more than it, then fights Cull Obsidian and Glaive to defend Vision in Wakanda.
While the others meet Shuri, Barnes and Falcon stand outside and watch the dropships crash into Wakanda's dome, then both fight in the battle.
Steve and Bucky hug in Wakanda ('How you been, Buck?'), fight in the battle, and Bucky says 'Steve?' as he turns to dust.
On the Benatar Drax tells Thor that Gamora is Thanos's daughter; on Knowhere he yells at Thanos for taking Gamora captive and Thanos turns him to pieces with the Reality Stone.
On the Benatar Quill tells Groot to put his game away, Groot swears, and the crew, Drax among them, reacts ('Whoa!' 'Language!' 'Hey!' 'Wow.').
On Knowhere Mantis makes Drax sleep when he charges Thanos too early; on Titan she says something is happening and turns to dust, and Drax watches in alarm before he goes too.
On Knowhere Quill tries to restrain Drax before Mantis puts him to sleep; on Titan Drax's last word is 'Quill?' as he turns to dust.
